steps.eval: (() => { const t = document.body.innerText; if (!/Complete investment/.test(t)) throw new Error('no Complete investment action'); if (/Send to escrow/.test([...document.querySelectorAll('.deal-card .btn')].map(b => b.textContent).join('|'))) throw new Error('card still says Send to escrow'); if (!document.querySelector('.deal-card .btn-action')) throw new Error('no action style'); if (!/Meridel Bio/.test(t)) throw new Error('no biotech deal'); })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText.toLowerCase(); if (!t.includes('minimum')) throw new Error('no minimum label'); if (!t.includes('of 250 members')) throw new Error('venture SPV should show a 250 cap'); })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText.toLowerCase(); if (!t.includes('join the waitlist')) throw new Error('northstar not full'); if (!t.includes('of 100 members')) throw new Error('secondary should cap at 100'); })()

(() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2')].find(h => /^Explore/.test(h.textContent.trim())); if (!h) throw new Error('no explore'); if (!document.querySelector('[role=tablist][aria-label="Explore by"]')) throw new Error('no explore menu'); h.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); })()
